text: How do you actually know if your first date went well? Let me break it down. Sign number one. Your intuition. If you walk away from the date and genuinely feel it went well, trust that instinct. Don't overthink every little detail. Your gut is often right. Sign number two. Physical contact. Whether it's holding hands, playful touching, or a kiss, these are clear signs of attraction. Physical connection shows she's comfortable and into you. Sign number three. Real connection. You laughed together, the time flew by, and for a while you forgot the world even existed. That chemistry is what separates an average date from a great one. Sign number four. She texts you after. If she thanks you for the evening or says she had a great time, that's a powerful signal she's interested in seeing you again. Now here's the truth. Even if you check all these boxes, sometimes life gets in the way. Maybe her ex popped back into her life, maybe she's just caught up with other things. Don't take it personally. But generally speaking, if the date felt good, it probably was good. So trust yourself, don't overcomplicate it, and simply ask her out again.
